newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,151 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,151 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume soared to 3,151 contracts on Sunday night, led by a surge in corn trading, according to the CBOT.
There were 138 wheat, 2,187 corn, 728 soybean, 63 soymeal, 33 soyoil and 2 oats futures contracts traded, along with 3 wheat call, 34 wheat put, 1 corn call and 2 soybean call option.

The overnight trend for corn was down three to 1-1/2 cents per bushel, soybeans down 5-3/4 to six cents, wheat down 4-1/2, soymeal down $0.70 a ton, soyoil down 0.14 cent a lb and oats down one cent per bushel.
